europe_now.title: Massive Protests and Security Operations Across France
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations and clashes have spread across multiple French cities, prompting the deployment of 70,000 police officers nationwide. Authorities have responded with tear gas as protesters and student groups voice widespread discontent against political figures and economic conditions.

sources.headline: France: Clashes erupt as protests sweep across cities
70,000 police forces deployed in France for tense day of protests

europe_now.title: Ukraine Restores Stable Satellite Communications
europe_now.summary: Defense officials in Ukraine have confirmed that Starlink and Starshield network connections are stable again following earlier operational limits. High-speed connectivity has been successfully recovered across the country's defensive infrastructure.

sources.headline: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
